unavailable.title: The console is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.description: The console did not return a usable session state. Open the bot menu in Telegram later, or request a new link from the bot.

noSession.title: Open the console from Telegram
noSession.description: Group administrators open the bot menu inside Telegram. Operators request a one-time link from {{botUsername}}.

steps.manager: Group administrators enter the console from the bot menu.
steps.operator: Operators request a one-time link from the bot.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.description: One-time links have a limited lifetime. Expiration does not mean that the account or console has failed.

steps.request: Request a new one-time link from {{botUsername}}.

redeemed.title: This link has already been used
redeemed.description: Someone else may have opened it first. Do not continue forwarding the original link.

steps.request: Request a new link from {{botUsername}} and confirm that it goes only to the intended operator.

noGroups.title: This account has not been authorized for any group
noGroups.description: The session is valid, but Telegram account {{accountId}} does not currently administer any available group.

steps.authorization: Ask the group owner to make this account a Telegram administrator, then open the console from the bot menu.

outsideTelegram.title: Group management opens only inside Telegram
outsideTelegram.description: This is an intentional security boundary. A normal browser cannot provide the signed identity data required for a group administrator.

steps.desktop: Open the {{botUsername}} menu in Telegram Desktop, then enter the console.

groups.title: Groups and channels
groups.description: Only groups this account may manage appear here. Select a group to continue to its waiting queue.
groups.liveGroupNote: After you select this group, later operations stay within its boundary.

loading.title: Loading groups…
loading.description: Checking which groups this account may manage.

empty.title: No manageable groups
empty.description: Account {{accountId}} has not been granted management access to any group. Ask a group owner to grant access.

authenticationExpired.title: Session expired
authenticationExpired.description: Open the console again from the Telegram bot menu, or request a new operator link from the bot.

authenticationInvalid.title: Session could not be verified
authenticationInvalid.description: Make sure you opened the console from an entry point provided by the Telegram bot.

initDataReplayed.title: This launch request was already used
initDataReplayed.description: Close this page, then open the console again from the Telegram bot menu.

authenticationUnavailable.title: Authentication service unavailable
authenticationUnavailable.description: Load the group list again after the service recovers.

verificationUnavailable.title: Group list unavailable
verificationUnavailable.description: The verification service is not ready, so manageable groups cannot be confirmed.

network.title: Console unreachable
network.description: Check the network connection, then load the group list again.

response.title: Group list could not be loaded
response.description: The console returned data that cannot be used.

unknown.title: Group list could not be loaded
unknown.description: The service refused the group-list request.

actions.openQueueFor: View the waiting queue for group {{id}}

mode.joinRestrictNote: People who do not pass are already in the group and can still read its messages.

prerequisites.heading: Verification prerequisites
prerequisites.joinRequestsEnabled: Join requests enabled for the group

groupRequired.title: Select a group first
groupRequired.description: Choose an authorized group before viewing its waiting queue.

noGroups.title: This account is not authorized for any groups
noGroups.description: The waiting queue only shows authorized groups.

feedback.releaseFailure: Could not release {{user}}. The application is still waiting and can be retried.

errors.authenticationExpired: The console session has expired. Open the console from Telegram again.
errors.authenticationInvalid: The console session cannot be verified. Open the console from Telegram again.
errors.accessDenied: You no longer have management permission for this group.
errors.accessUnavailable: Your management permission for this group cannot be verified right now. Try again.
errors.chatNotFound: This group is no longer available in the console.
errors.challengeConflict: Another administrator has already handled this application. The queue has been refreshed.
errors.csrfInvalid: This page's security token has expired. Refresh the page before trying again.
errors.invalidSettlement: This application cannot be released now. Refresh the queue and try again.
errors.loadUnavailable: The waiting queue is temporarily unavailable.
errors.network: The connection was interrupted. Refresh the waiting queue before deciding whether to retry.
errors.queueUnavailable: The waiting queue cannot be read right now. Try again.
errors.settlementUnavailable: The application cannot be released right now. Try again.
errors.targetProtected: This applicant is a group administrator and cannot be released here.
errors.targetUnavailable: The applicant's group membership cannot be verified. Try again.

empty.title: No one has applied yet
empty.description: Waiting applicants appear here after the first application arrives.

filteredEmpty.title: No records match the current filters
